prompt:
Character action-pose sheet for a video game. Not a scene, not a user
interface, and not pixel art.

EDIT INPUT IMAGE 1 by replacing its entire three-row sprite sheet with one
clean horizontal row of exactly six Cel Shift male technician figures. Keep
the six top-row pose silhouettes and replace all original character design,
costume, props, effects, pixel rendering, and background.

STRICT REFERENCE ADHERENCE — INPUT IMAGE 1 is the RPG sprite sheet. Use input
image 1 for the exact six body poses, silhouettes, facing directions, gesture
arcs, ordering, and spacing. INPUT IMAGE 2 is the canonical Cel Shift male
technician sheet. Use input image 2 for the character's identity, proportions,
PPE, palette, and rendering style. Preserve the heroic sword-and-shield
readability, but redesign every object as original Midcreek industrial
equipment rather than copying the fantasy character or heraldry.

LAYOUT — exactly six separate full-body figures in one evenly spaced horizontal
row, left to right:

1. Neutral ready stance holding a long insulated service blade/tool low in the
   right hand and a compact rack-door shield on the left arm.
2. Wide planted stance making a powerful horizontal sweep with the service
   blade/tool, with one clean amber motion arc.
3. Wide stance with the left hand extended, releasing a circular teal
   diagnostic pulse made from cable and network motifs.
4. Crouched braced stance behind the rack-door shield as a bright contact spark
   hits its edge.
5. Full running stride toward the right with the cloak-free hi-vis silhouette
   and tool belt trailing naturally.
6. Upright heroic signal pose with the service blade/tool raised high overhead
   and the rack-door shield held at the side.

HYBRID EQUIPMENT — the sword silhouette becomes an original long insulated
busbar extraction tool: straight steel-grey working edge, safety-orange grip,
industrial fasteners, and no medieval ornament. The shield silhouette becomes
a compact oval or round-cornered rack access panel with perforated metal,
yellow hazard edging, a central service latch, and a forearm brace. Effects
look like graphic diagnostic energy and electrical contact, not supernatural
magic. No crests, fleurs-de-lis, runes, gems, heraldry, or recognizable fantasy
weapon design.

THE CHARACTER — the canonical Cel Shift man technician, identical across all
six poses. Adult proportions, roughly six-and-a-half heads tall, average build,
1.73 m, clean-shaven with no beard, moustache, or stubble. Short dark hair
under a blue hard hat with ear defenders. Lime yellow-green hi-vis vest with
orange trim and broad silver retroreflective bands over a long-sleeved slate
work shirt. Blue straight-cut denim jeans, brown work boots, tool belt, and
corded orange ear plugs.

STYLE — Cel Shift. Large flat unbroken colour areas, at most one hard-edged
cool shadow tone, and thick confident uniform-weight dark outlines around
silhouettes and major internal forms. Clear adult anatomy, dynamic readable
poses, and a light airy palette. Plain warm off-white studio background with no
scenery, grid, or labels. Small flat ground ellipses are allowed.

Palette: background #F0EDE4, hi-vis lime #C8D94A, orange trim #E8763A,
retroreflective silver #D6DBE0, slate shirt #55707F, denim #4A6485, boots
#3A3128, hard hat #2C6FB8, steel #AEB8C2, teal diagnostic accent #2FB8A8,
warning yellow #FFC93C, amber effect #F5A623, ink outline #23282D.

CONSTRAINTS — exactly six figures and no extras. No overlapping figures. No
lettering, numerals, words, logos, watermark, signature, decorative frame, or
interface. No photorealism, gradients, ambient occlusion, texture, grain, glow
bloom, depth of field, motion blur, cute proportions, chibi style, medieval
armor, conventional sword or shield, spell runes, foliage, or flames.
